touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Long Bennington qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST SWITHIN and Churchyard cross, St Swithun's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Long Bennington: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Long Bennington offers CHURCH OF ST SWITHIN, Churchyard cross, St Swithun's churchyard, CROSS 5M TO SOUTH OF CHURCH OF ST. SWITHIN within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST SWITHIN
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST SWITHIN and Churchyard cross, St Swithun's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.

dontMiss: CROSS 5M TO SOUTH OF CHURCH OF ST. SWITHIN
